# SPC Flooring Wear Layer Guide: 0.2mm, 0.3mm and 0.5mm Explained

SPC flooring is a practical product for distributors, contractors and project buyers, but the right specification depends on the target market, traffic level, installation environment and price position.

This guide explains how importers, distributors, contractors and brand owners can evaluate **wear layer selection** when sourcing SPC flooring from China. The goal is to help buyers make a real purchasing decision before asking for price, samples or container loading plans.

## Why this matters

Many buyers compare only the unit price. That is risky. Two products with the same name can perform very differently when the raw material, production control, surface finish, edge quality, packing and after-sales responsibility are different.

For wholesale orders, a wrong specification can lead to slow sales. For project orders, it can lead to installation complaints, replacement cost and delivery pressure. A serious buyer should define the application first, then match the specification, price level and supplier capability.

## What buyers should check

- Application: residential, commercial, hotel, school, retail, office or renovation.
- Specification: thickness, size, surface finish, wear layer or panel structure.
- Quantity: sample order, trial order, mixed container or full container.
- Packing: carton strength, pallet plan, private label requirement and loading method.
- Supplier support: production photos, inspection records, delivery updates and clear responsibility.

## Practical recommendation

0.2mm wear layer is usually used for price-sensitive residential sales. 0.3mm is a balanced option for many distributors. 0.5mm is better for commercial or heavier-traffic projects. The wear layer should match total thickness, core stability and target selling price.

Buyers should ask suppliers to explain why a specification is recommended. A professional manufacturer should not only send a price list. It should help the buyer compare cost, performance, loading quantity and market positioning.

## Questions to ask before ordering

1. What specification do you recommend for my market and why?
2. Can you provide samples and production photos?
3. What is the MOQ for trial order and repeat order?
4. Can you support OEM packaging or mixed container loading?

# SPC Flooring for Hotels: What Contractors and Distributors Should Choose

## Quick Answer

For most B2B buyers, the safest choice is not the cheapest SPC flooring quotation. The safer choice is the specification that matches the application, can be checked by samples, can be packed safely for export and can be repeated with stable quality.

## Who This Article Is For

SPC Flooring for Hotels: What Contractors and Distributors Should Choose is written for importers, distributors, contractors and private-label buyers who need a practical way to choose SPC flooring before placing a bulk order. The question is not only which product looks good in photos. Buyers need to understand hotel rooms, corridors, serviced apartments and commercial guest areas, because these details affect quotation accuracy, market feedback, installation complaints and repeat orders.

This article is especially useful for flooring distributors building a catalog, contractors sourcing for one project, importers comparing factories, and brand owners planning OEM or private-label cartons. It can also help new buyers prepare clearer inquiries before asking a China manufacturer for price.

## Key Specification and Buying Table

The table below gives buyers a practical way to compare SPC flooring hotels before asking for a final quotation.

| Buyer check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Market position | Entry residential, distributor stock, premium project or commercial supply |
| Core specification | 4mm / 5mm / 6mm thickness, wear layer, click system and optional IXPE backing |
| Sample approval | Confirm color, surface texture, locking profile, thickness and backing before bulk order |
| Packing check | Review carton strength, labels, pallet method, loading quantity and photo records |
| Supplier support | Ask for OEM packaging, production updates, QC photos and export coordination |

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Define the application before choosing thickness or wear layer.
- Ask whether the quoted price includes backing, carton design, pallet packing or only basic product.
- Compare samples by thickness, surface, locking profile, backing, edge quality and odor.
- Confirm packing and loading quantity before you calculate landed cost.
- Keep one signed or photographed sample as the reference for mass production.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Comparing 4mm, 5mm or 6mm prices without checking wear layer and IXPE backing.
- Approving a color from a screen image instead of a physical sample.
- Ignoring carton strength and then facing damaged boxes after long-distance transport.
- Choosing a supplier who cannot provide production progress or loading photos.
- Treating one trial order as only a price test instead of a full supplier reliability test.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

## Recommended Choice by Market or Project

When evaluating hotel rooms, corridors, serviced apartments and commercial guest areas, build a simple product ladder. Use an entry specification for price-sensitive channels, a balanced specification for distributor stock, and a higher specification for hotels, offices, schools or other commercial projects. This approach helps buyers avoid one-size-fits-all purchasing and gives sales teams clearer answers when local customers ask why one option costs more than another.

For distributors, the goal is usually not to carry every possible option. A focused product range is easier to explain, easier to stock and easier to reorder. For project buyers, the goal is different: the specification must match the site requirement, installation method, schedule and after-sales expectation.

## Packing, MOQ, Samples and OEM Notes

Before placing a formal order, buyers should ask how samples, MOQ, packing and OEM support are handled. For SPC flooring, these details are closely connected to real landed cost and customer satisfaction.

For SPC flooring, trial orders should confirm color range, thickness, wear layer, IXPE requirement, carton information and pallet loading. For full-container orders, buyers should also confirm loading photos, carton labels, batch control and whether the supplier can keep the same specification for repeat orders.

If OEM packaging is required, do not wait until production has started. Carton artwork, labels, barcodes and insert cards should be confirmed before mass production, so the supplier can avoid rework and shipment delays.

## How Eshsire Supports B2B Buyers

Eshsire manufactures SPC flooring and supports importers, distributors and project buyers with specification selection, sample orders, OEM/private-label packaging, production follow-up, inspection communication and export shipment coordination. Buyers can also review related information through [SPC Flooring](/en/spc-flooring), [Wall Panels](/en/wall-panels), [OEM Service](/en/oem-service), [Contact Eshsire](/en/contact), [Mixed Container Solutions](/en/mixed-container-spc-flooring-wall-panels).

## Final Advice

The best supplier decision is the one that reduces uncertainty. Before buying SPC flooring from China, ask the supplier to explain the recommended specification, provide sample support, confirm packing details and show how quality will be checked before shipment. A clear process protects both sides and creates a better foundation for repeat business.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What should I confirm first when sourcing SPC flooring hotels?

Start with application, expected traffic level, target thickness, wear layer, backing requirement, quantity and destination. These details allow the supplier to recommend a practical SPC flooring specification instead of only sending a general price list.

### Can Eshsire support sample orders before a container order?

Yes. Samples can be used to check color, surface texture, thickness, click quality, backing and general construction before confirming a bulk order.

### Can SPC flooring be supplied with OEM packaging?

Yes. OEM cartons, labels, barcodes and private-label support can be discussed after color, specification and order quantity are confirmed.

### Can SPC flooring be mixed with wall panels or accessories?

Yes, when loading weight and volume are suitable. Mixed-container planning can help buyers combine flooring, wall panels, ceiling panels and accessories in one shipment.

## Quick Answer

For most B2B buyers, the safest choice is not the cheapest SPC flooring quotation. The safer choice is the specification that matches the application, can be checked by samples, can be packed safely for export and can be repeated with stable quality.

## Who This Article Is For

Why the Cheapest SPC Flooring Quote Can Become Expensive is written for importers, distributors, contractors and private-label buyers who need a practical way to choose SPC flooring before placing a bulk order. The question is not only which product looks good in photos. Buyers need to understand thickness, wear layer, IXPE, click system, packing and distributor positioning, because these details affect quotation accuracy, market feedback, installation complaints and repeat orders.

This article is especially useful for flooring distributors building a catalog, contractors sourcing for one project, importers comparing factories, and brand owners planning OEM or private-label cartons. It can also help new buyers prepare clearer inquiries before asking a China manufacturer for price.

## Key Specification and Buying Table

The table below gives buyers a practical way to compare cheap quote risk before asking for a final quotation.

| Buyer check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Market position | Entry residential, distributor stock, premium project or commercial supply |
| Core specification | 4mm / 5mm / 6mm thickness, wear layer, click system and optional IXPE backing |
| Sample approval | Confirm color, surface texture, locking profile, thickness and backing before bulk order |
| Packing check | Review carton strength, labels, pallet method, loading quantity and photo records |
| Supplier support | Ask for OEM packaging, production updates, QC photos and export coordination |

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Define the application before choosing thickness or wear layer.
- Ask whether the quoted price includes backing, carton design, pallet packing or only basic product.
- Compare samples by thickness, surface, locking profile, backing, edge quality and odor.
- Confirm packing and loading quantity before you calculate landed cost.
- Keep one signed or photographed sample as the reference for mass production.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Comparing 4mm, 5mm or 6mm prices without checking wear layer and IXPE backing.
- Approving a color from a screen image instead of a physical sample.
- Ignoring carton strength and then facing damaged boxes after long-distance transport.
- Choosing a supplier who cannot provide production progress or loading photos.
- Treating one trial order as only a price test instead of a full supplier reliability test.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

# How to Avoid Quality Problems in SPC Flooring Orders

## Quick Answer

For most B2B buyers, the safest choice is not the cheapest SPC flooring quotation. The safer choice is the specification that matches the application, can be checked by samples, can be packed safely for export and can be repeated with stable quality.

## Who This Article Is For

How to Avoid Quality Problems in SPC Flooring Orders is written for importers, distributors, contractors and private-label buyers who need a practical way to choose SPC flooring before placing a bulk order. The question is not only which product looks good in photos. Buyers need to understand pre-shipment inspection, click fit, dimensions and surface checks, because these details affect quotation accuracy, market feedback, installation complaints and repeat orders.

This article is especially useful for flooring distributors building a catalog, contractors sourcing for one project, importers comparing factories, and brand owners planning OEM or private-label cartons. It can also help new buyers prepare clearer inquiries before asking a China manufacturer for price.

## Key Specification and Buying Table

The table below gives buyers a practical way to compare avoid quality problems before asking for a final quotation.

| Buyer check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Market position | Entry residential, distributor stock, premium project or commercial supply |
| Core specification | 4mm / 5mm / 6mm thickness, wear layer, click system and optional IXPE backing |
| Sample approval | Confirm color, surface texture, locking profile, thickness and backing before bulk order |
| Packing check | Review carton strength, labels, pallet method, loading quantity and photo records |
| Supplier support | Ask for OEM packaging, production updates, QC photos and export coordination |

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Define the application before choosing thickness or wear layer.
- Ask whether the quoted price includes backing, carton design, pallet packing or only basic product.
- Compare samples by thickness, surface, locking profile, backing, edge quality and odor.
- Confirm packing and loading quantity before you calculate landed cost.
- Keep one signed or photographed sample as the reference for mass production.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Comparing 4mm, 5mm or 6mm prices without checking wear layer and IXPE backing.
- Approving a color from a screen image instead of a physical sample.
- Ignoring carton strength and then facing damaged boxes after long-distance transport.
- Choosing a supplier who cannot provide production progress or loading photos.
- Treating one trial order as only a price test instead of a full supplier reliability test.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

## Recommended Choice by Market or Project

When evaluating pre-shipment inspection, click fit, dimensions and surface checks, build a simple product ladder. Use an entry specification for price-sensitive channels, a balanced specification for distributor stock, and a higher specification for hotels, offices, schools or other commercial projects. This approach helps buyers avoid one-size-fits-all purchasing and gives sales teams clearer answers when local customers ask why one option costs more than another.

For distributors, the goal is usually not to carry every possible option. A focused product range is easier to explain, easier to stock and easier to reorder. For project buyers, the goal is different: the specification must match the site requirement, installation method, schedule and after-sales expectation.

## Packing, MOQ, Samples and OEM Notes

Before placing a formal order, buyers should ask how samples, MOQ, packing and OEM support are handled. For SPC flooring, these details are closely connected to real landed cost and customer satisfaction.

For SPC flooring, trial orders should confirm color range, thickness, wear layer, IXPE requirement, carton information and pallet loading. For full-container orders, buyers should also confirm loading photos, carton labels, batch control and whether the supplier can keep the same specification for repeat orders.

If OEM packaging is required, do not wait until production has started. Carton artwork, labels, barcodes and insert cards should be confirmed before mass production, so the supplier can avoid rework and shipment delays.

# How to Choose a Supplier Who Takes Responsibility After the Order

## Quick Answer

For most B2B buyers, the safest choice is not the cheapest wall panels quotation. The safer choice is the specification that matches the application, can be checked by samples, can be packed safely for export and can be repeated with stable quality.

## Who This Article Is For

How to Choose a Supplier Who Takes Responsibility After the Order is written for distributors, project buyers, contractors and interior-material importers who want to reduce risk before buying wall panels from China. The decision should connect design, specification and installation. Buyers need to understand panel type, size, thickness, accessories, installation method and mixed-container planning, because a wall panel order is only successful when the panels, accessories, packing and site use all match.

This article is especially useful for importers selecting panel series, distributors building a showroom, contractors preparing project quotations, and buyers who want to combine wall panels with SPC flooring, ceiling panels and accessories in one shipment.

## Key Specification and Buying Table

The table below gives buyers a practical way to compare responsible supplier before asking for a final quotation.

| Buyer check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Panel type | SPC, WPC, PVC, UV marble, decorative, fluted or ceiling panel |
| Size and thickness | Confirm width, length, thickness, edge style and installation method |
| Accessory plan | Corners, trims, skirting, clips, adhesive or keel system depending on panel type |
| Sample check | Review surface, color, joint, stiffness, backing and packing before bulk order |
| Mixed order | Combine wall panels with SPC flooring, ceiling panels and accessories when practical |

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Confirm the room type and wall condition before choosing panel material.
- Compare panel width, length, thickness, surface, edge style and matching accessories together.
- Ask for installation guidance before quoting the project to a local contractor.
- Plan trims, corners, skirting and clips at the same time as the panel order.
- Check carton packing, loading method and mixed-container possibility before confirming the final price.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Buying panels first and looking for matching accessories after installation starts.
- Choosing a color only from catalog images without checking the real surface sample.
- Ignoring wall flatness, cutting loss and corner details in project calculation.
- Comparing WPC, PVC, SPC and UV marble panels as if they are the same product.
- Forgetting that a low panel price can become expensive if trims, packing or installation are not planned.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

## Recommended Choice by Market or Project

For panel type, size, thickness, accessories, installation method and mixed-container planning, divide the order into product, accessory and installation decisions. A wall panel quotation should not only list square meters. It should also show panel type, size, trim requirement, packing method and whether the order can be combined with other interior materials.

For distributors, the goal is usually not to carry every possible option. A focused product range is easier to explain, easier to stock and easier to reorder. For project buyers, the goal is different: the specification must match the site requirement, installation method, schedule and after-sales expectation.

## Packing, MOQ, Samples and OEM Notes

Before placing a formal order, buyers should ask how samples, MOQ, packing and OEM support are handled. For wall panels, these details are closely connected to real landed cost and customer satisfaction.

For wall panels, trial orders should confirm panel type, width, length, thickness, surface finish, trims, corners and installation method. For full-container or mixed-container orders, buyers should also confirm carton packing, accessory quantities and whether ceiling panels or SPC flooring can be combined in one shipment.

If OEM packaging is required, do not wait until production has started. Carton artwork, labels, barcodes and insert cards should be confirmed before mass production, so the supplier can avoid rework and shipment delays.

Eshsire supplies wall panels, SPC flooring, PVC ceiling panels and accessories for global B2B buyers. We help buyers compare product type, size, installation details, packing and mixed-container planning before confirming the order. ## Final Advice

The best supplier decision is the one that reduces uncertainty. Before buying wall panels from China, ask the supplier to explain the recommended specification, provide sample support, confirm packing details and show how quality will be checked before shipment. A clear process protects both sides and creates a better foundation for repeat business.

### What should I confirm first when sourcing responsible supplier?

Start with panel type, size, thickness, surface design, application area, required accessories, installation method, quantity and destination. These details make the quotation more accurate.

### Can I request wall panel samples before a bulk order?

Yes. Samples help buyers check real color, surface texture, stiffness, edge quality and accessory matching before confirming a larger order.

### Should wall panel accessories be ordered together with panels?

Yes. Corners, trims, skirting, clips, adhesive or keel materials should be planned together so the final installation looks complete.

### Can wall panels be shipped together with SPC flooring?

Yes. Eshsire can help plan mixed-container orders when the product combination, carton protection and loading weight are suitable.

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Define the application before choosing thickness or wear layer.
- Ask whether the quoted price includes backing, carton design, pallet packing or only basic product.
- Compare samples by thickness, surface, locking profile, backing, edge quality and odor.
- Confirm packing and loading quantity before you calculate landed cost.
- Keep one signed or photographed sample as the reference for mass production.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Comparing 4mm, 5mm or 6mm prices without checking wear layer and IXPE backing.
- Approving a color from a screen image instead of a physical sample.
- Ignoring carton strength and then facing damaged boxes after long-distance transport.
- Choosing a supplier who cannot provide production progress or loading photos.
- Treating one trial order as only a price test instead of a full supplier reliability test.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

## Recommended Choice by Market or Project

When evaluating thickness, wear layer, IXPE, click system, packing and distributor positioning, build a simple product ladder. Use an entry specification for price-sensitive channels, a balanced specification for distributor stock, and a higher specification for hotels, offices, schools or other commercial projects. This approach helps buyers avoid one-size-fits-all purchasing and gives sales teams clearer answers when local customers ask why one option costs more than another.

For distributors, the goal is usually not to carry every possible option. A focused product range is easier to explain, easier to stock and easier to reorder. For project buyers, the goal is different: the specification must match the site requirement, installation method, schedule and after-sales expectation.

## Packing, MOQ, Samples and OEM Notes

Before placing a formal order, buyers should ask how samples, MOQ, packing and OEM support are handled. For SPC flooring, these details are closely connected to real landed cost and customer satisfaction.

For SPC flooring, trial orders should confirm color range, thickness, wear layer, IXPE requirement, carton information and pallet loading. For full-container orders, buyers should also confirm loading photos, carton labels, batch control and whether the supplier can keep the same specification for repeat orders.

If OEM packaging is required, do not wait until production has started. Carton artwork, labels, barcodes and insert cards should be confirmed before mass production, so the supplier can avoid rework and shipment delays.

# How to Build Long-Term Wall Panel Supply with a China Factory

## Quick Answer

For most B2B buyers, the safest choice is not the cheapest wall panels quotation. The safer choice is the specification that matches the application, can be checked by samples, can be packed safely for export and can be repeated with stable quality.

## Who This Article Is For

How to Build Long-Term Wall Panel Supply with a China Factory is written for distributors, project buyers, contractors and interior-material importers who want to reduce risk before buying wall panels from China. The decision should connect design, specification and installation. Buyers need to understand panel type, size, thickness, accessories, installation method and mixed-container planning, because a wall panel order is only successful when the panels, accessories, packing and site use all match.

This article is especially useful for importers selecting panel series, distributors building a showroom, contractors preparing project quotations, and buyers who want to combine wall panels with SPC flooring, ceiling panels and accessories in one shipment.

## Key Specification and Buying Table

The table below gives buyers a practical way to compare wall panel supply chain before asking for a final quotation.

| Buyer check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Panel type | SPC, WPC, PVC, UV marble, decorative, fluted or ceiling panel |
| Size and thickness | Confirm width, length, thickness, edge style and installation method |
| Accessory plan | Corners, trims, skirting, clips, adhesive or keel system depending on panel type |
| Sample check | Review surface, color, joint, stiffness, backing and packing before bulk order |
| Mixed order | Combine wall panels with SPC flooring, ceiling panels and accessories when practical |

## What Buyers Should Check Before Ordering

A good inquiry gives the factory enough information to recommend the right specification. Before confirming the order, buyers should check the following points:

- Confirm the room type and wall condition before choosing panel material.
- Compare panel width, length, thickness, surface, edge style and matching accessories together.
- Ask for installation guidance before quoting the project to a local contractor.
- Plan trims, corners, skirting and clips at the same time as the panel order.
- Check carton packing, loading method and mixed-container possibility before confirming the final price.

In many cases, two suppliers may use the same product name but quote different constructions, packing methods or service levels. This is why buyers should compare the full order package, not only the square-meter price.

## Common Mistakes Importers Make

The problems below are common in first-time or price-driven purchasing. They can be avoided with a clearer approval process:

- Buying panels first and looking for matching accessories after installation starts.
- Choosing a color only from catalog images without checking the real surface sample.
- Ignoring wall flatness, cutting loss and corner details in project calculation.
- Comparing WPC, PVC, SPC and UV marble panels as if they are the same product.
- Forgetting that a low panel price can become expensive if trims, packing or installation are not planned.

When a buyer only checks the quotation total, these details are easy to miss. But after the goods arrive, they become real costs: slow sales, customer complaints, repacking work, installation delays or difficulty selling repeat orders.

## Recommended Choice by Market or Project

For panel type, size, thickness, accessories, installation method and mixed-container planning, divide the order into product, accessory and installation decisions. A wall panel quotation should not only list square meters. It should also show panel type, size, trim requirement, packing method and whether the order can be combined with other interior materials.

For distributors, the goal is usually not to carry every possible option. A focused product range is easier to explain, easier to stock and easier to reorder. For project buyers, the goal is different: the specification must match the site requirement, installation method, schedule and after-sales expectation.

## Packing, MOQ, Samples and OEM Notes

Before placing a formal order, buyers should ask how samples, MOQ, packing and OEM support are handled. For wall panels, these details are closely connected to real landed cost and customer satisfaction.

For wall panels, trial orders should confirm panel type, width, length, thickness, surface finish, trims, corners and installation method. For full-container or mixed-container orders, buyers should also confirm carton packing, accessory quantities and whether ceiling panels or SPC flooring can be combined in one shipment.

If OEM packaging is required, do not wait until production has started. Carton artwork, labels, barcodes and insert cards should be confirmed before mass production, so the supplier can avoid rework and shipment delays.

## Final Advice

The best supplier decision is the one that reduces uncertainty. Before buying wall panels from China, ask the supplier to explain the recommended specification, provide sample support, confirm packing details and show how quality will be checked before shipment. A clear process protects both sides and creates a better foundation for repeat business.

Start with panel type, size, thickness, surface design, application area, required accessories, installation method, quantity and destination. These details make the quotation more accurate.

### Can I request wall panel samples before a bulk order?

Yes. Samples help buyers check real color, surface texture, stiffness, edge quality and accessory matching before confirming a larger order.

Yes. Corners, trims, skirting, clips, adhesive or keel materials should be planned together so the final installation looks complete.
